title: Maa Beti
desc: Savitri, a wealthy woman who dies during childbirth. Her husband remarries Laxmi, who, influenced by her brother Raghunandan, mistreats Savitri’s children, Meenu and Khetan. The children run away, and years later, Laxmi's daughter, Chanda, discovers the truth about her half-siblings and their tragic past

title: Ustadon Ke Ustad
desc: Vishwanath and Jaikishan are two thieves and good friends. When they try to lead an honest life for the sake of their women, Pukhraj turns them against each other and the two become sworn enemies.

title: Aao Pyar Karein
desc: When the times comes for a wealthy man to marry, his parents find a suitable match, but he goes against their wishes and marries a woman from a poor family. He moves out of his palatial family home and goes to live with his wife.

title: Zulm O Sitam
desc: Superintendent of Police, Arun, has been assigned to lead the detail in charge of the state's Chief Minister's protection. However, things do not go as planned and the Chief Minister is killed.

title: Ghar Jamai
desc: Dwarka, a millionaire, is impressed by Anil, a principled man, and wants him to marry Mona, his daughter. However, after their marriage, he compels him to move into his house.
